content: {"episode_id":"ep-05056","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for episode ep-05056, as the service was medically necessary for this patient. The clinical indication note documents a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I49.9, I48.91, and R55. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period. We request reconsideration of the precertification determination and payment of the outstanding balance of $615.60."}
